data_policy: Wholly synthetic reference definitions. No reviews, labels or measured results.
notes: Status 'draft': proposed reviewer rubric v2 for owner review (F4 PR-B). Nothing here is approved; rubric v1 (in both definitions files) is unchanged.
Exactly two designated independent primary reviewers per dimension (min_independent_reviewers: 2); a distinct designated adjudicator only when they disagree (third_reviewer). No majority voting.

N/A is allowed only for the listed reasons, and only when the review item carries the matching pinned expectation. A reviewer may not choose N/A because an output omitted required information; that is scored. evidence_support and explanation_clarity have no N/A.
Review items, output slots and applicability expectations are caller-declared in this contract version; structural consistency with a pinned case does not prove they were derived from it.
No adjudication record exists. Nothing is genuinely reportable until a trusted evaluation-record service exists.

dimensions.description: Every material statement is supported by cited, current, authorized evidence
Missing, contested or inferred facts are shown as such, never filled in
A coordinator can follow the rule and evidence trail
The suggestion supports a concrete follow-up decision only
